idea-plugin.name: AgentNav ACP
idea-plugin.description:
AgentNav ACP — Cursor-style coding agent for JetBrains IDEs

Brings Claude Code straight into IntelliJ as a fully interactive coding agent, with native diff review, multi-tab chats, MCP servers, skills, and session resume — without ever leaving your IDE. Works with your existing Claude subscription plan (no API key, no extra billing).

Highlights

  • Multi-tab chats — every conversation gets its own isolated Claude process. New, rename, and close tabs from the tool window.
  • Resume previous sessions — pick any past Claude conversation from disk (across all projects), with search and "current project only" filter.
  • Native IntelliJ diff viewer auto-opens on every file change. Accept or Reject per-file, or in batch from the Pending Changes panel.
  • In-place model / permission-mode / effort switching — change Opus ↔ Sonnet ↔ Haiku, acceptEdits/plan/bypass, Low/Medium/High/Max thinking, all from the input toolbar without losing your conversation history.
  • Plan mode preview — when Claude proposes file changes in plan mode, a yellow preview card lets you open the proposed content as a virtual scratch file before approving.
  • Permission prompts — Bash/MCP tool requests surface as Allow/Deny cards inline in the chat (via --permission-prompt-tool stdio).
  • MCP integration — connected servers and their tools listed in a dedicated menu, with status icons (🟢 connected · 🔑 needs-auth · ❌ failed). Custom --mcp-config path configurable in Settings.
  • Skills & slash commands — Claude Code skills (built-in and custom) appear in a dedicated dropdown, grouped by type.
  • Prompt history per session with prompt-to-prompt and prompt-to-current diff comparisons.
  • Drag & drop files · paste images · @-mention any file in the project.
  • Pluggable transport — Claude Code via native CLI stream-json (stays on your subscription plan, no Agent SDK billing), or OpenCode / any ACP-compatible agent via the standard ACP protocol.

Requirements

  • Claude Code CLI ≥ 2.1.0 (curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash), signed in once via claude. The plugin relies on the bidirectional stream-json protocol introduced in 2.1 (control_request / can_use_tool permission flow). Versions < 2.1 will not surface Allow/Deny cards correctly.
  • Optional: npx in PATH (auto-detected from nvm/volta) for OpenCode and MCP servers spawned via npm.
  • JetBrains IDE 2024.2 or newer.

Open Tools → AgentNav ACP for settings, or use the tool window on the right after install.
